verdict.rationale: Bitbucket offers automatic security scans through an out-of-the-box Snyk integration in the repo Security tab, with the option to connect other providers. Third-party code reports can be viewed in PRs and enforced through merge checks, so results can be surfaced in one place, but scanning depends on external vendors rather than being native. missing for 10: native scanners, explicit coverage of static analysis, dependency, secret, and dynamic scanning types, any evidence of secret or DAST scanning, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
